headline: Borsa Istanbul closes higher as BIST 100 gains 0.82%
summary: The Borsa Istanbul BIST 100 index closed the trading session on November 26, 2026, with a 0.82% gain, reaching 10,743.11 points.
why: The BIST 100 is the primary benchmark index for the Turkish stock market, reflecting investor sentiment toward the country's economy.
